2024年全国高中数学联赛二试A卷第2题（40分）。
原题：在凸四边形ABCD中，AC平分∠BAD，E、F分别在边BC、CD上，满足EF∥BD。分别延长FA、EA至点P、Q，使过A,B,P的圆以及过A,D,Q的圆均与AC相切。证明B,P,Q,D四点共圆。
我的坐标证明（完整保留几何假设，不将结论写进假设）：
第1步。以A为原点，AC为正x轴，长度尺度固定；由于AC平分角BAD，可取实数u,v满足u²+v²=1、u>0、v>0，并取b,d,c>0，使B=(bu,bv)，D=(du,-dv)，C=(c,0)。这里b=AB、d=AD、c=AC。
第2步。因E∈BC、F∈CD且EF∥BD，依据以C为中心的相似比，存在共同参数0<t<1，使E=C+t(B-C)=(c(1-t)+tbu,tbv)，F=C+t(D-C)=(c(1-t)+tdu,-tdv)。这一步准确使用了原题的平行条件。
第3步。任何过原点且在原点切x轴的圆均有方程x²+y²+λy=0。通过B的第一圆系数λ_1=-b/v，通过D的第二圆系数λ_2=d/v，这是分别代入B,D并用u²+v²=1得到的。
第4步。由于P位于FA的延长线过A的另一侧，可写P=pF且p<0；因为P在第一圆上，代入得p²|F|²-(b/v)pF_y=0。由F_y=-tdv、p≠0，得p=-bdt/|F|²。完全类似，由Q=qE在第二圆上且E_y=tbv，得到q=-bdt/|E|²。记h=bdt，则P=-hF/|F|²、Q=-hE/|E|²。
第5步。四个互异点U_i=(x_i,y_i)共圆，当且仅当行列式det[(x_i²+y_i²,x_i,y_i,1)]_{i=1}^4=0。取顺序B,D,P,Q，并代入上面的显式坐标。分母|E|²|F|²均严格为正。
第6步。直接通分展开该4×4行列式，其分子必含因子u²+v²-1；事实上逐项整理得到行列式为 b²c d²t³ v(b-d)(t-1)(u²+v²-1)[b²(u²+v²)-2bd u²+2bd v²+d²(u²+v²)]/(|E|²|F|²)。由于u²+v²=1，该值严格等于0。代数整理仅使用第1至4步显式坐标和恒等式，无须新增原题几何假设。
第7步。因此B,D,P,Q四点位于同一个圆上，即B,P,Q,D共圆。证毕。

result.proofTerm:
by
  intro u v b d c t Ex Ey Fx Fy Px Py Qx Qy
  intro hu hu0 hv0 hb hd hc ht ht1 hEx hEy hFx hFy hconv hPline hPopp hPcirc hQline hQopp hQcirc
  have hvne : v ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hv0
  have source_step_0 : 0 < u ∧ 0 < v ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < d ∧ 0 < c ∧ u ^ 2 + v ^ 2 = 1 := ⟨hu0, hv0, hb, hd, hc, hu⟩
  have source_step_1 : Ex = c * (1 - t) + t * b * u ∧ Ey = t * b * v ∧ Fx = c * (1 - t) + t * d * u ∧ Fy = - (t * d * v) := ⟨hEx, hEy, hFx, hFy⟩
  have source_step_2 : ((b * u) ^ 2 + (b * v) ^ 2 - (b / v) * (b * v) = 0) ∧ ((d * u) ^ 2 + (- (d * v)) ^ 2 + (d / v) * (- (d * v)) = 0) := by
    constructor
    · field_simp [hvne]
      ring_nf
      nlinarith [hu]
    · field_simp [hvne]
      ring_nf
      nlinarith [hu]
  have hFy_neg : Fy < 0 := by
    rw [hFy]
    have hpos : 0 < t * d * v := by positivity
    linarith
  have hFy_ne : Fy ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hFy_neg
  have hEy_pos : 0 < Ey := by
    rw [hEy]
    positivity
  have hEy_ne : Ey ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hEy_pos
  have hFy_sq_pos : 0 < Fy ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hFy_ne
  have hNf_pos : 0 < Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg Fx, hFy_sq_pos]
  have hNf_ne : Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hNf_pos
  have hEy_sq_pos : 0 < Ey ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hEy_ne
  have hNe_pos : 0 < Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg Ex, hEy_sq_pos]
  have hNe_ne : Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hNe_pos
  have source_step_3 :
      Px = - (b * d * t) * Fx / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) ∧
      Py = - (b * d * t) * Fy / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) ∧
      Qx = - (b * d * t) * Ex / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) ∧
      Qy = - (b * d * t) * Ey / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) := by
    have hlineP : Px * Fy = Py * Fx := by linarith [hPline]
    have hPy_ne : Py ≠ 0 := by
      intro hpy0
      have hpx2 : Px ^ 2 = 0 := by simpa [hpy0] using hPcirc
      have hpx0 : Px = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hpx2
      have hdot : Px * Fx + Py * Fy = 0 := by simp [hpx0, hpy0]
      linarith [hPopp, hdot]
    have hfacP : Py * (Py * (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) - (b / v) * Fy ^ 2) = 0 := by
      have hsq : (Px * Fy) ^ 2 = (Py * Fx) ^ 2 := by rw [hlineP]
      have hmul : (Px ^ 2 + Py ^ 2 - (b / v) * Py) * Fy ^ 2 = 0 := by
        rw [hPcirc]
        ring
      have hsq' : Px ^ 2 * Fy ^ 2 = Py ^ 2 * Fx ^ 2 := by
        calc
          Px ^ 2 * Fy ^ 2 = (Px * Fy) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (Py * Fx) ^ 2 := hsq
          _ = Py ^ 2 * Fx ^ 2 := by ring
      have htmp : Py ^ 2 * (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) - (b / v) * Py * Fy ^ 2 = 0 := by
        nlinarith [hmul, hsq']
      calc
        Py * (Py * (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) - (b / v) * Fy ^ 2)
            = Py ^ 2 * (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) - (b / v) * Py * Fy ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 0 := htmp
    have hfactorP : Py * (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) - (b / v) * Fy ^ 2 = 0 := by
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hfacP).resolve_left hPy_ne
    have hPy_formula0 : Py = (b / v) * Fy ^ 2 / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) := by
      have hEq : Py * (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) = (b / v) * Fy ^ 2 := by linarith [hfactorP]
      calc
        Py = (Py * (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2)) / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) := by field_simp [hNf_ne]
        _ = ((b / v) * Fy ^ 2) / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) := by rw [hEq]
    have hPy_formula : Py = - (b * d * t) * Fy / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) := by
      rw [hPy_formula0, hFy]
      have hNf_expr_ne : Fx ^ 2 + (- (t * d * v)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by simpa [hFy] using hNf_ne
      field_simp [hvne, hNf_expr_ne]
      ring
    have hPx_formula : Px = - (b * d * t) * Fx / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) := by
      have hlineDiv : Px = Py * Fx / Fy := by
        field_simp [hFy_ne]
        linarith [hlineP]
      rw [hlineDiv, hPy_formula]
      field_simp [hFy_ne, hNf_ne]
      ring
    have hlineQ : Qx * Ey = Qy * Ex := by linarith [hQline]
    have hQy_ne : Qy ≠ 0 := by
      intro hqy0
      have hqx2 : Qx ^ 2 = 0 := by simpa [hqy0] using hQcirc
      have hqx0 : Qx = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hqx2
      have hdot : Qx * Ex + Qy * Ey = 0 := by simp [hqx0, hqy0]
      linarith [hQopp, hdot]
    have hfacQ : Qy * (Qy * (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) + (d / v) * Ey ^ 2) = 0 := by
      have hsq : (Qx * Ey) ^ 2 = (Qy * Ex) ^ 2 := by rw [hlineQ]
      have hmul : (Qx ^ 2 + Qy ^ 2 + (d / v) * Qy) * Ey ^ 2 = 0 := by
        rw [hQcirc]
        ring
      have hsq' : Qx ^ 2 * Ey ^ 2 = Qy ^ 2 * Ex ^ 2 := by
        calc
          Qx ^ 2 * Ey ^ 2 = (Qx * Ey) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (Qy * Ex) ^ 2 := hsq
          _ = Qy ^ 2 * Ex ^ 2 := by ring
      have htmp : Qy ^ 2 * (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) + (d / v) * Qy * Ey ^ 2 = 0 := by
        nlinarith [hmul, hsq']
      calc
        Qy * (Qy * (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) + (d / v) * Ey ^ 2)
            = Qy ^ 2 * (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) + (d / v) * Qy * Ey ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 0 := htmp
    have hfactorQ : Qy * (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) + (d / v) * Ey ^ 2 = 0 := by
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hfacQ).resolve_left hQy_ne
    have hQy_formula0 : Qy = - (d / v) * Ey ^ 2 / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) := by
      have hEq : Qy * (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) = - (d / v) * Ey ^ 2 := by linarith [hfactorQ]
      calc
        Qy = (Qy * (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2)) / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) := by field_simp [hNe_ne]
        _ = (- (d / v) * Ey ^ 2) / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) := by rw [hEq]
    have hQy_formula : Qy = - (b * d * t) * Ey / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) := by
      rw [hQy_formula0, hEy]
      have hNe_expr_ne : Ex ^ 2 + (t * b * v) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by simpa [hEy] using hNe_ne
      field_simp [hvne, hNe_expr_ne]
      ring
    have hQx_formula : Qx = - (b * d * t) * Ex / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) := by
      have hlineDiv : Qx = Qy * Ex / Ey := by
        field_simp [hEy_ne]
        linarith [hlineQ]
      rw [hlineDiv, hQy_formula]
      field_simp [hEy_ne, hNe_ne]
      ring
    exact ⟨hPx_formula, hPy_formula, hQx_formula, hQy_formula⟩
  have hPx_formula : Px = - (b * d * t) * Fx / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) := source_step_3.1
  have hPy_formula : Py = - (b * d * t) * Fy / (Fx ^ 2 + Fy ^ 2) := source_step_3.2.1
  have hQx_formula : Qx = - (b * d * t) * Ex / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) := source_step_3.2.2.1
  have hQy_formula : Qy = - (b * d * t) * Ey / (Ex ^ 2 + Ey ^ 2) := source_step_3.2.2.2
  have hSpos : 0 < 2 * u * (c * (1 - t)) + t * (b + d) := by
    have h1 : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
    have hk : 0 < c * (1 - t) := mul_pos hc h1
    have h2u : 0 < 2 * u := by nlinarith [hu0]
    have hpart1 : 0 < 2 * u * (c * (1 - t)) := mul_pos h2u hk
    have hbd : 0 < b + d := by linarith
    have hpart2 : 0 < t * (b + d) := mul_pos ht hbd
    linarith
  have hSne : 2 * u * (c * (1 - t)) + t * (b + d) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hSpos
  have source_step_4 :
      ∃ α β γ : ℝ,
        (b * u) ^ 2 + (b * v) ^ 2 + α * (b * u) + β * (b * v) + γ = 0 ∧
        (d * u) ^ 2 + (- (d * v)) ^ 2 + α * (d * u) + β * (- (d * v)) + γ = 0 ∧
        Px ^ 2 + Py ^ 2 + α * Px + β * Py + γ = 0 ∧
        Qx ^ 2 + Qy ^ 2 + α * Qx + β * Qy + γ = 0 := by
    let α : ℝ := - (c * (1 - t) * (b + d)) / (2 * u * (c * (1 - t)) + t * (b + d))
    let β : ℝ := ((d - b) * (u * (c * (1 - t)) + t * (b + d))) / (v * (2 * u * (c * (1 - t)) + t * (b + d)))
    let γ : ℝ := - (b * d * t * (b + d)) / (2 * u * (c * (1 - t)) + t * (b + d))
    use α, β, γ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [α, β, γ]
      field_simp [hSne, hvne]
      ring_nf
      nlinarith [hu]
    · dsimp [α, β, γ]
      field_simp [hSne, hvne]
      ring_nf
      nlinarith [hu]
    · dsimp [α, β, γ]
      rw [hPx_formula, hPy_formula, hFx, hFy]
      have hNf_expr_ne : (c * (1 - t) + t * d * u) ^ 2 + (- (t * d * v)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        simpa [hFx, hFy] using hNf_ne
      field_simp [hSne, hvne, hNf_expr_ne]
      ring_nf
      nlinarith [hu]
    · dsimp [α, β, γ]
      rw [hQx_formula, hQy_formula, hEx, hEy]
      have hNe_expr_ne : (c * (1 - t) + t * b * u) ^ 2 + (t * b * v) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        simpa [hEx, hEy] using hNe_ne
      field_simp [hSne, hvne, hNe_expr_ne]
      ring_nf
      nlinarith [hu]
  have source_step_5 :
      ∃ α β γ : ℝ,
        (b * u) ^ 2 + (b * v) ^ 2 + α * (b * u) + β * (b * v) + γ = 0 ∧
        (d * u) ^ 2 + (- (d * v)) ^ 2 + α * (d * u) + β * (- (d * v)) + γ = 0 ∧
        Px ^ 2 + Py ^ 2 + α * Px + β * Py + γ = 0 ∧
        Qx ^ 2 + Qy ^ 2 + α * Qx + β * Qy + γ = 0 := by
    exact source_step_4
  have source_step_6 :
      ∃ α β γ : ℝ,
        (b * u) ^ 2 + (b * v) ^ 2 + α * (b * u) + β * (b * v) + γ = 0 ∧
        (d * u) ^ 2 + (- (d * v)) ^ 2 + α * (d * u) + β * (- (d * v)) + γ = 0 ∧
        Px ^ 2 + Py ^ 2 + α * Px + β * Py + γ = 0 ∧
        Qx ^ 2 + Qy ^ 2 + α * Qx + β * Qy + γ = 0 := by
    exact source_step_5
  exact source_step_6

source.raw:
2024年全国高中数学联赛二试A卷第2题（40分）。
原题：在凸四边形ABCD中，AC平分∠BAD，E、F分别在边BC、CD上，满足EF∥BD。分别延长FA、EA至点P、Q，使过A,B,P的圆以及过A,D,Q的圆均与AC相切。证明B,P,Q,D四点共圆。
我的坐标证明（完整保留几何假设，不将结论写进假设）：
第1步。以A为原点，AC为正x轴，长度尺度固定；由于AC平分角BAD，可取实数u,v满足u²+v²=1、u>0、v>0，并取b,d,c>0，使B=(bu,bv)，D=(du,-dv)，C=(c,0)。这里b=AB、d=AD、c=AC。
第2步。因E∈BC、F∈CD且EF∥BD，依据以C为中心的相似比，存在共同参数0<t<1，使E=C+t(B-C)=(c(1-t)+tbu,tbv)，F=C+t(D-C)=(c(1-t)+tdu,-tdv)。这一步准确使用了原题的平行条件。
第3步。任何过原点且在原点切x轴的圆均有方程x²+y²+λy=0。通过B的第一圆系数λ_1=-b/v，通过D的第二圆系数λ_2=d/v，这是分别代入B,D并用u²+v²=1得到的。
